suggestions.why: Your version said "like this MedlinePlus case report", but the case report isn't MedlinePlus's: it's Patel and Marzella 2017 on PubMed Central ([the report](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5580516/)). MedlinePlus was the page on what serotonin syndrome looks like, which your version folded in. So the article now says "like this case report", and the MedlinePlus page is linked on your first words, "Serotonin syndrome", where the reader meets the term. I left "Reviews keep warning ..., like this case report" as you wrote it: the reviews do warn, and the case report shows the risk they warn about.
suggestions.advice_note: Keep the fix. If you want MedlinePlus named, say where, and I'll check that wording.
